scope: The fifteen malformed opred-family tokens denied by EDIT-0066, on fourteen exact lines in papers 1-43.
choice: Repair each token to its sentence-required official oprěděl-family form, including agreement, passive morphology, verbal-noun form, present conjugation, and one analytic co-determination recast.
motivation: These sites could not safely receive spelling-only normalization. Exact German and sentence syntax distinguish plural nominalized indeterminates, passive participles, verbal nouns, contracted present forms, and the unattested so- compound.
alternatives_rejected: Blind accenting would preserve malformed endings and conjugations.
Global definiovati would lose determine/indeterminate functions.
Preserving national variants would leave a mixed paradigm.

evidence.context_review: All fifteen sites were resolved against their local case, number, tense, and German semantic role; soopreděljeno became analytic takože oprěděljeno.

validation.residue: zero unaccented opred-family residue and exactly 559 canonical family tokens
validation.structure: TeX controls, references, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
validation.reproducibility: Frozen hashes reproduced before atomic apply
